reviews.text: A great afternoon, with new encounters and lots of new furry friends! But always well-groomed!

Very happy with the grooming! Malaurie is attentive, very gentle, and offers excellent advice!
I highly recommend her!

Naïa's first grooming session at Groomi went wonderfully! 🐶 Malaurie is a kind, attentive, and very pleasant person. I was able to stay with Naïa to reassure her, and the time flew by as we chatted so much. 😊
Plus, she's very skilled at cocker spaniel cuts, and the result is perfect! 😍 I highly recommend Groomi! 🫶🏼

Thanks to Mallorie for the super convenient puppy package, perfect for a gentle introduction. With treats, gentleness, and skill, my 4-month-old standard poodle let me clean his muzzle and paws, and he'll be in good hands for his first bath next month!

I took Achille, my toy poodle (little devil), to GROOMI for grooming. He came out looking handsome, soft, and smelling amazing!

I highly recommend them. They took the time to pinpoint the cut I wanted, taking into account all the specifics, and I left very satisfied.
And the icing on the cake, or rather two:

- Malaurie loves animals, you can see it and smell it!

- My little devil has never played with another dog as much as he did with Spoon; it was so cute to see!
I would go back without hesitation!
Before and after photos!
Thank you again for taking such good care of my dog ​​Sunny. He came out very happy and not stressed at all; it was perfect. The groomer was gentle and patient in taking care of my dog.

This is the second puppy training session for our little Yuzu, a 4-month-old Eurasier. The salon is beautiful, pleasant, and clean; we feel very comfortable there. Malaurie is a gentle and patient professional who understands the little dogs she works with very well. My little puppy is sensitive and not very comfortable with new things or being handled. So we chose to do the puppy training in 3 sessions over 3 months and will continue to come regularly so she can gain confidence and get used to it. Malaurie talks to our little one as if she were her own dog, and she cares for her as if she were her life partner. She knows how to set firm boundaries with a lot of kindness to make the experience as pleasant as possible. She also gives a wealth of invaluable advice. We highly recommend her!

I highly recommend this salon. It's so much more than just a grooming salon, and Malaurie is very professional, attentive, and adaptable. Thank you, I'm absolutely delighted, and Athena looks beautiful! 😍 …
